name: ERP System Upgrade — SAP S/4HANA Migration
description: Full-scale migration of the corporate ERP platform from legacy SAP ECC 6.0 to SAP S/4HANA 2023. The programme encompasses system architecture redesign, custom ABAP re-engineering, master data cleansing, ETL pipeline development for GL and sub-ledger data, integration with peripheral systems (HR, Procurement, Treasury), and a phased finance UAT programme culminating in a hard go-live before the financial year-end close. Data migration is the critical-path workstream; a data quality issue discovered during profiling of the GL_ACCOUNTS table is currently blocking migration design.
